test_save_pretrained: test the ModelHubMixin.save_pretrained method saves config.json from init arguments or explicit config parameter
test_from_pretrained: test the ModelHubMixin.from_pretrained method loads config.json and reconstructs model instances from saved state
test_push_to_hub: test the ModelHubMixin.push_to_hub method uploads model config.json to a Hugging Face Hub repository
test_custom_type_serialization: test ModelHubMixin custom coders serialize and deserialize non-primitive init arguments via config.json
test_inherited_class_attributes: test ModelHubMixin mixin info attributes like repo_url, paper_url, and library_name are inherited by subclasses
